skill.summary: Bitbucket Cloud wrapper optimized for Pull Request Code Analysis. Enables the agent to securely review Pull Requests, split large diffs by file, review code...

latestVersion.changelog:
bitbucket-toolbox 1.1.2

- Expanded the PR review guidelines to require exhaustive, in-depth analysis for every changed file, encouraging reviewers to dig deep and surface as many findings as possible.
- Clarified the expectation to be thorough and not stop at the first few obvious issues, emphasizing a higher bar for comprehensive code review.
- No changes to commands or functionality; documentation update only.
